kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE (NOT (labels.device RLIKE "rootfs") OR (labels.device IS NULL AND NOT ("" RLIKE "rootfs")))
| WHERE metrics.node_filesystem_avail_bytes IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_filesystem_avail_bytes = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_filesystem_avail_bytes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.mountpoint
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE (NOT (labels.device RLIKE "rootfs") OR (labels.device IS NULL AND NOT ("" RLIKE "rootfs")))
| WHERE metrics.node_filesystem_files_free IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_filesystem_files_free = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_filesystem_files_free)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.mountpoint
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_filefd_maximum IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_filefd_allocated IS NOT NULL
| STATS Max_open_files = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_filefd_maximum)), Open_files = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_filefd_allocated)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Max_open_files, Open_files
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE (NOT (labels.device RLIKE "rootfs") OR (labels.device IS NULL AND NOT ("" RLIKE "rootfs")))
| WHERE metrics.node_filesystem_files IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_filesystem_files = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_filesystem_files)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.mountpoint
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE (NOT (labels.device RLIKE "rootfs") OR (labels.device IS NULL AND NOT ("" RLIKE "rootfs")))
| WHERE metrics.node_filesystem_readonly IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_filesystem_device_error IS NOT NULL
| STATS ReadOnly = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_filesystem_readonly)), Device_error = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(CASE(((NOT (labels.fstype RLIKE "tmpfs") OR (labels.fstype IS NULL AND NOT ("" RLIKE "tmpfs")))), metrics.node_filesystem_device_error, NULL), 5m)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.mountpoint
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.mountpoint`, ReadOnly, Device_error
| SORT time_bucket ASC
